reading.action: Keep going (eyes still closed) to find one more foe before turning back; the skin-crawl hasn't gone away.
reading.result: BLIND SENSE-BEAT, ends PRE-BLOW (iris-prep ruling). Advanced room-2-cleared -> the gallery mouth; the PAIR ACTIVATED (sensed him, began to converge/flank) but NO blow landed. TIER-3 HEAT-JAM (the t75-foreshadowed break-point): false heat washing in everywhere DENIES his eyes-closed locate/count/warmth-discrimination/flanker-tracking. STILL RELIABLE: the skin-crawl essence itself -> he feels MORE THAN ONE real wrong thing moving to flank, can't pin them. INT 20 deduction: the haven throwing heat at the exact sense he switched to => the heat is FALSE and his method is being countered here; the crutch failing IS the tell. Ends on a genuine DECIDE-POINT (engage / open eyes / turn back), retreat open at the gallery mouth. NO pool change (no roll, no contested action, negligible walk). NO sheet progression -> system_card None -> NO system card. No assume of his next move. Ch5 OPEN. Pair stats on file for if/when he engages (each L4, 82 HP, physDef 11, physAtk 30.5, Init 27, base 14, mentDef 26.5, 2d10; gate 0.25 decoy / 1.8 revealed-true / 53-70 trust-opener; tier-3 tell = MIRRORS). NO Tower reset.
